plan.title: Plan preview
plan.preview_text: Nothing is mounted or copied until you run it. This list comes from the same code that runs the backup.
plan.how_text: Every command runs as a list of arguments, never through a shell. Only these programs are allowed:
plan.how_source: The source is read-only. Nothing is written to it, and nothing leaves your Home Assistant.
plan.origin_text: The {{type}} type builds this plan. HomeBackup adds the steps around it, the same for every type.
plan.type_files: The type is a folder with two files:
plan.flags_none: This plan has no rsync step.
plan.no_delete: Not used. Delete is off for this item.

flags.-a: Archive mode: copy folders and keep times, permissions, owners and links.
flags.-r: Copy folders and everything in them.
flags.-t: Keep file times, so unchanged files are skipped next time.
flags.-rt: Copy folders and keep file times.
flags.-R: Keep the folder layout from the source.
flags.--no-perms: Do not copy permissions. Drives such as exFAT cannot store them.
flags.--no-owner: Do not copy the file owner.
flags.--no-group: Do not copy the file group.
flags.--modify-window=2: Treat times within 2 seconds as equal. exFAT keeps times in 2-second steps.
flags.--partial: Keep half-copied files, so a large copy can resume.
flags.--delete: Delete files on the target that are gone from the source (mirror).
flags.--dry-run: Only show what would change. Nothing is copied.
flags.--info=progress2: Report progress for the whole copy, which feeds the progress bar.
flags.--outbuf=L: Send output line by line, so the live log stays current.
flags.--stats: Print totals at the end: files and bytes copied.
flags.--mkpath: Create the target folder when it does not exist yet.

plan.steps_line: {{steps}}, {{commands}}. Select a step to open or close it.
plan.device_note: {device} is filled in with the drive found in the find step.
plan.result_warning: Exit code 23 (partial transfer) or 24 (files vanished while copying).
plan.result_failure: Any other exit code, or a problem finding, mounting or unmounting the target, a failed check or a conflict.
